{#- Supplier Order Confirmation V3 version of the native "PO - Commercial Invoice" format: the order as the supplier confirmed it. Lines are the confirmed qty at the confirmed rate (lines with nothing coming now drop out; a substituted line is the substitute item); totals and taxes are the confirmation's; the order number, addresses and dates of the order come from the PO3 it confirms. -#} {%- set po = frappe.get_doc("Purchase Order V3", doc.purchase_order_v3) -%} {%- set po_no = po.erp_purchase_order or po.name -%} {%- set net_ratio = (doc.net_total / doc.total) if doc.total else 1 -%} {%- set lines = [] -%} {%- for d in doc.items if (d.confirmed_qty or 0) > 0 -%} {%- set amount = (d.confirmed_qty or 0) * (d.confirmed_rate or 0) -%} {%- set sub = d.substitute_item_code if d.line_status == "Substituted" and d.substitute_item_code else None -%} {%- set _ = lines.append({"item_code": sub or d.item_code, "item_name": frappe.db.get_value("Item", sub, "item_name") if sub else d.item_name, "supplier_part_no": frappe.db.get_value("Item Supplier", {"parent": sub, "supplier": doc.supplier}, "supplier_part_no") if sub else d.supplier_part_no, "retail_sku_suffix": frappe.db.get_value("Item", sub, "ifw_retailskusuffix") if sub else d.retail_sku_suffix, "qty": d.confirmed_qty, "rate": d.confirmed_rate, "amount": amount, "net_rate": d.net_rate if d.net_amount else (d.confirmed_rate or 0) * net_ratio, "net_amount": d.net_amount if d.net_amount else amount * net_ratio}) -%} {%- endfor -%}

{{doc.supplier}}

{{ po.address_display or '' }}

INVOICE

Invoice Date: {{ frappe.utils.format_date(doc.confirmation_date) }}

Invoice No: {{ po_no }}

{% if po.billing_address_display %}
BILL TO
{{ po.billing_address_display or '' }}
{% endif %}
SHIP TO
{{ po.shipping_address_display or '' }}
{% for row in lines %} {% set item_doc = frappe.get_doc("Item", row.item_code) %} {% endfor %}
DESCRIPTION QTY UNIT PRICE COUNTRY OF ORIGIN HS CODE TOTAL
{{ row.item_name }} {{ row.qty }} {{ frappe.format_value(row.net_rate, {'fieldtype': 'Currency'}) }} {{ item_doc.country_of_origin or '' }} {{ item_doc.customs_tariff_number or '' }} {{ frappe.format_value(row.net_amount, {'fieldtype': 'Currency'}) }}
SUBTOTAL: {{ frappe.format_value(doc.net_total, {'fieldtype': 'Currency'}) }}
DISCOUNT: {{ frappe.format_value(doc.discount_amount or 0.00, {'fieldtype': 'Currency'}) }}
SUBTOTAL LESS DISCOUNT: {{ frappe.format_value(doc.net_total - (doc.discount_amount or 0.00), {'fieldtype': 'Currency'}) }}
TAX RATE: {{ doc.taxes[0].rate|string + '%' if doc.taxes else '0.00%' }}
TOTAL TAX: {{ frappe.format_value(doc.total_taxes_and_charges, {'fieldtype': 'Currency'}) }}
BALANCE DUE: {{ frappe.format_value(doc.grand_total, {'fieldtype': 'Currency'}) }}
name: PO - Commercial Invoice - SOC3
